title: Bib Collection Readiness Overdue Aging by Status
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=race:bib
| eval days_overdue=round((now()-pickup_deadline_epoch)/86400,1)
| where days_overdue>0
| stats avg(days_overdue) as avg_days_overdue max(days_overdue) as max_days_overdue count as items by pickup_status
| sort - avg_days_overdue
description: Measures how long overdue bib collection readiness work is staying stuck in each status.
value: Aging by status shows whether the bottleneck is waiting on you, a vendor, a family member, or missing paperwork.
implementation: Review this weekly and tighten the workflow stage that owns the oldest overdue records.
visualization: Bar chart of average overdue days by status.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers where overdue bib pickups are getting stuck instead of moving to done.
